11bb4c8f411c.name: Will of Iron
11bb4c8f411c.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, this Warlord can take a Deny the Witch test like a PSYKER against one power manifested by an enemy model within 24" of it. A LIBRARIAN Warlord can instead attempt to deny one more psychic power than usual in your opponent's Psychic phase.

12ea3f2cf2e6.name: Wrathful Machine Spirit
12ea3f2cf2e6.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE models is chosen to shoot or fight. Until the end of the phase, that model can re-roll hit rolls for its attacks.

1515292fcca7.name: Betrayer's Bane - Meltagun
1515292fcca7.plain: Attacks with this weapon's meltagun profile have a Damage characteristic of D6+2 when they target a unit within half range.

1a23fbedfece.name: 4) Psysteel Armor
1a23fbedfece.plain: Warp charge 6: one of your IRON HANDS units within 12" of this psyker adds 1 to its saving throws (not invulnerable saves) until your next Psychic phase starts.

2758ee43d2ba.name: March of the Ancients
2758ee43d2ba.plain: Once per battle, before the battle, after you nominate your WARLORD: pick one of your IRON HANDS DREADNOUGHT models. It gains the CHARACTER keyword, and you add 1 to its Attacks and Leadership characteristics.

291e664abc4e.name: Merciless Logic
291e664abc4e.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for this Warlord's attacks lets you make 1 additional attack with the same weapon against the same unit. That extra attack can't generate any further attacks.

2a3cfcb4dff3.name: 2) Objuration Mechanicum
2a3cfcb4dff3.plain: Warp charge 7: one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this psyker suffers mortal wounds when it rolls unmodified 1s to hit with ranged weapons. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged weapon attack and the hit roll is an unmodified 1, the unit suffers 1 mortal wound after that attack is resolved.

33c11ffb8307.name: 3) Fury of Medusa
33c11ffb8307.plain: Warp charge 6: pick one enemy model within 18" of and visible to this psyker; its unit and every other enemy unit in the way can suffer mortal wounds. Draw the shortest possible imaginary straight line, 1mm wide, from this psyker's base to that model's base. Roll one D6 for that model's unit and for each other enemy unit the line crosses, adding 2 if the unit is a VEHICLE. On a 4-5, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

41a71da197af.name: Signum Array
41a71da197af.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your IRON HANDS units within 3" of this model. Add 1 to hit rolls for ranged attacks by its models until your next Command phase starts.

47f650b9c3a5.name: All Flesh is Weakness
47f650b9c3a5.plain: Roll one D6 each time this Warlord would lose a wound: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

5631c8cdf85d.name: Rites of Tempering
5631c8cdf85d.plain: While their unit is within 6" of this model, INFANTRY models in your IRON HANDS units get a 5+ invulnerable save.

7b12704a38c4.name: Optimal Repulsion Doctrines
7b12704a38c4.plain: Use in your opponent's Charge phase, when one of your IRON HANDS units fires Overwatch. Until the end of the phase, Overwatch attacks by models in that unit hit on a roll of 5 or 6. If the unit has The Flesh is Weak Chapter Tactic, they hit on a roll of 4-6 instead.

7becc2feda90.name: Paragon of Iron
7becc2feda90.plain: Once per battle, before the battle, after you nominate an IRON HANDS CHARACTER model that is not a named character as your WARLORD: it can have one extra Warlord Trait, which must come from the Iron Hands Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly).

7e00ec62003d.name: Methodical Firepower
7e00ec62003d.plain: Use at the start of your Movement phase while the Devastator Doctrine is not active: pick one of your IRON HANDS units. Until your next Movement phase starts, attacks by models in that unit are resolved as if the Devastator Doctrine were active, on top of whichever doctrine currently is.

8372d9f8816d.name: Artificer Bionics
8372d9f8816d.plain: Roll one D6 each time this model would lose a wound; on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

8b7d5bcb70b3.name: Scion of the Forge
8b7d5bcb70b3.plain: Use before the battle: pick one of your IRON HANDS models with the word 'Sergeant' in its profile. Even though it is not a CHARACTER, that model can have one of these Special-issue Wargear Relics: Master-crafted Weapon, Digital Weapons, Teeth of Mars or Haywire Bolts. Every Relic in your army must be different and on a different model.

8ea7df801fd5.name: Cogitated Martyrdom
8ea7df801fd5.plain: At the start of the Shooting phase: pick one of your IRON HANDS INFANTRY units. Until the end of the phase, if an attack made against one of your IRON HANDS CHARACTER models (excluding VEHICLE models) within 3" of that unit would make it lose any wounds, the unit can try to intercept that attack. Before any rolls to ignore wounds are made (such as The Flesh is Weak or Adamantine Mantle), roll one D6: on a 2+, the CHARACTER does not lose those wounds and the unit suffers 1 mortal wound per wound instead. Only one attempt to intercept can be made for each attack.

a32b6fd597c9.name: 5) Reforge
a32b6fd597c9.plain: Warp charge 5: one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE models within 3" of and visible to this psyker regains up to D3 lost wounds. A model that has regained any lost wounds earlier this turn can't be picked.

a92e608f3a36.name: The Ironstone
a92e608f3a36.plain: At the start of each battle round, pick one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE units within 3" of the bearer; it can take 1 less damage from each attack. This lasts until the start of your next battle round, and only works while the bearer is within 3" of that unit. You choose whether to reduce the damage, it can't go below 1, and this doesn't stack with any other rules that reduce damage.

bc38bf1d5af5.name: Machine Empathy
bc38bf1d5af5.plain: Use in your Movement phase, after one of your IRON HANDS TECHMARINE models has used its Blessing of the Omnissiah ability. It can use that ability one more time.

c36c99d14508.name: Mercy Is Weakness
c36c99d14508.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your IRON HANDS units is chosen to shoot or fight, and pick one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, every attack by a model in that IRON HANDS unit that can target the picked unit must do so, but each unmodified wound roll of 6 for those attacks wounds the target unit twice instead of once.

caeabe15063d.name: Engine Purge
caeabe15063d.plain: Once per battle, use at the start of your Movement phase while the Devastator Doctrine is active. From then until the start of the next battle round, when one of your IRON HANDS models attacks with a Heavy or Grenade weapon and the wound roll is an unmodified 6, that weapon's Armour Penetration characteristic improves by a further 1 for that attack.

ce01d081c106.name: 6) Machine Flense
ce01d081c106.plain: Warp charge 6: an enemy VEHICLE unit within 18" of and visible to this psyker suffers D3 mortal wounds, which can spill over onto a nearby enemy unit. You can then pick another enemy unit that the VEHICLE unit could see, and that was within 6" of it, at the moment this power was manifested. Roll one D6 per mortal wound the VEHICLE unit suffered; each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that other unit.

ce41dc363d00.name: Reject the Flesh, Embrace the Machine
ce41dc363d00.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your IRON HANDS INFANTRY units is chosen as the target of an attack. Until the end of the phase, roll one D6 each time a model in that unit would lose a wound (models with the All Flesh is Weakness Warlord Trait add 1 to the roll). On a 5+, the wound is not lost.

d2c4841023b0.name: The Aegis Ferrum
d2c4841023b0.plain: The model with this Relic adds 1 to its Toughness characteristic, and each attack against it has its damage reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1. Only a PRIMARIS model can take this Relic.

d37064054ebd.name: Student of History
d37064054ebd.plain: When this Warlord consolidates, it can move up to 6" instead of 3", and it doesn't have to finish that move closer to the nearest enemy model.

d44a70acf0a5.name: Vengeance for Isstvan V
d44a70acf0a5.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your IRON HANDS units is chosen to fight. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit can re-roll hit rolls for melee weapon attacks against WORD BEARERS, IRON WARRIORS, NIGHT LORDS or ALPHA LEGION units.

db1c08e773b8.name: 1) Blessing of the Machine God
db1c08e773b8.plain: Warp charge 5: one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE models within 12" of this psyker adds 1 to its hit rolls until the start of your next Psychic phase. It can only be a TITANIC model if the Psychic test result was 8 or more.

dda5b0907abe.name: Souls of Iron
dda5b0907abe.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, after any Deny the Witch attempt, when an enemy PSYKER model manifests a power within 24" of one of your IRON HANDS units. Roll one D6: on a 4+, the power is resisted.

dea3db450e8c.name: Target Protocols
dea3db450e8c.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one of your IRON HANDS units within 6" of this Warlord: it gets a hit, a wound and a damage re-roll that phase. Each can be used once that phase, on a ranged weapon attack by a model from that unit.

e3eba3bd3815.name: The Tempered Helm
e3eba3bd3815.plain: While the model with this Relic is on the battlefield, each Command Point you spend on Stratagems lets you roll one D6: on a 5+, that point is refunded. This Relic refunds at most 1 Command Point per battle round.

e93ec1cb7a28.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
e93ec1cb7a28.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may repair one of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE models within 3" of it: the VEHICLE regains up to 3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

eefdca5ddd31.name: The Flesh Is Weak
eefdca5ddd31.plain:
Models with this tactic shrug off wounds on a 6, and count as having double their wounds remaining for damage-based characteristics.
• Roll one D6 each time a model with this tactic would lose a wound: on a 6, the wound is not lost.
• If a model with this tactic has characteristics that change as it suffers damage, treat it as having twice its remaining wounds when working out what those characteristics are.

f1381722852b.name: Bequeathed by the Iron Council
f1381722852b.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate a model from an Iron Hands successor Chapter as your WARLORD: one CHARACTER model in your army from an Iron Hands successor Chapter can have one Relic of Medusa instead of a Special-issue Wargear Relic or a Chapter Relic. If it does, every IRON HANDS keyword on that Relic (if any) is swapped for that model's <CHAPTER> keyword.

f8d6a5d3a4f8.name: The Gorgon’s Rage
f8d6a5d3a4f8.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your IRON HANDS units is chosen to fight. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for melee weapon attacks made by its models, and also add 1 to wound rolls for those attacks when they target an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.

fca7766b5f96.name: The Gorgon's Chain
fca7766b5f96.plain: The model with this Relic gets a 4+ invulnerable save, and you subtract 1 from the wound roll for each ranged weapon attack against it.
